implementation_note: Calls VerifyMembershipProof(userID; layerID; witnessA; accumulatorStr). Chaincode loads RSA accumulator state from CouchDB; deserializes 1024-bit N and A; computes H(userID) = hash_to_group(userID); then evaluates witness^H(userID) mod N (real RSA 1024-bit modular exponentiation) and compares with A. witnessA is set to the current A value to trigger a full-size RSA exp; verification returns false (invalid witness) but the compute cost is identical to a successful verification. Prototype limitation: AccumulatorState does not persist per-user witnesses; a valid witness requires RSA secrets (p;q) or per-transaction computation which is discarded after block commit.
